stats.label: Time to refocus after an interruption

blocks.text: Why Slack matters for digital product testers

Digital product testers rely on fast communication. You need to report bugs, sync with developers, and share test results. Slack is often the central hub for these tasks. However, it can become a source of constant distraction. Managing your time in Slack is as important as testing the software itself.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Stop using your mouse for everything. Keyboard shortcuts keep your hands on the keys and your mind on the work. Press Command + / to see the full list of shortcuts inside the Slack app. Here are the ones you will use most often as a tester.

items: Command + K: Opens the quick switcher to jump to any channel or direct message.
Command + G: Opens the general search bar to find past bug reports.
Command + F: Searches for keywords within your current channel or conversation.
Shift + Enter: Adds a new line to your message instead of sending it.
Command + ,: Opens your Slack preferences instantly.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps testers in Slack

Lazur is a voice assistant for your Mac that lives in the notch. It helps you control your environment without leaving your current window. Hold Option + Command to ask Lazur questions about your screen. If you are stuck on a Slack setting, ask Lazur to point at it. It will draw a circle around the button you need.

Constant pings kill your flow. As a tester, you need deep focus to reproduce bugs. You can pause notifications in Slack to protect your testing time. Go to your profile menu, select Pause notifications, and choose a duration. You can also use the /dnd command in any text field.

Sometimes the Slack app on macOS gets sluggish. This happens if you have many workspaces open or a large cache. To fix this, go to the menu bar and select Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This usually resolves minor UI glitches and performance lags.

Threads are vital for keeping bug discussions organized. Never reply to a bug report in the main channel. Always use the thread view. You can open the threads view by clicking the icon in the sidebar or using the dedicated shortcut. This keeps the main channel clean for everyone.
Search tips for finding bug reports

Searching is a core skill for testers. Use search modifiers to narrow down results. For example, type from:@username to find messages from a specific developer. Use in:#channelname to search within a specific project channel. Adding has:file helps you find screenshots or logs attached to bug reports.

If a developer asks you to re-test a bug later, do not leave it to memory. Hover over their message, click the three dots, and select Remind me about this. You can set it for 20 minutes, an hour, or a custom time. Slack will ping you exactly when it is time to check the fix.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps. It points at things and guides you one step at a time.

faq.question: Is Slack on Mac compatible with older versions?
faq.answer: Slack requires macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer for the latest versions. It is best to keep your OS updated.

faq.question: How do I find all keyboard shortcuts in Slack?
faq.answer: Press Command + / while the Slack desktop app is active to see the built-in cheat sheet.
